author: Ilya
text:
The regatta with Sofa was my first experience of this kind and I am absolutely thrilled!

Seven days at sea on a yacht, dinners in restaurants, watching films on a projector, handling the sails of a big cruising yacht — it's the kind of experience you really have to live through yourself. Of all the kinds of holiday out there, this is the one I liked most.

If you like a sea breeze and a bright starry sky, if you love adventures and are ready for them — I definitely recommend it!
